name: r134a_turbine_power
title: R134a turbine of 5 kW driving a compressor (exercise)
summary: An R134a turbine with an isentropic efficiency of 78 % delivers 5 kW. After the alternator, 57 % of the electricity drives an R134a compressor. The model computes the common mass flow and the compressor outlet pressure.

verification.summary: Against the stored solution of R04_E3_2022.EES, compare_solution.py --ees-units: 24 common variables, 8 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 24. Those 8 are absolute enthalpies and entropies (R134a reference offset). Maximum relative difference 4.65e-01 on s_in_cp. Turbine power is -5000 W on both sides; mass flow is 0.231233 kg/s against 0.231286 kg/s.
verification.reference: EES stored solution in R04_E3_2022.EES (24 variables, EES X10.836)
verification.notes: 24 common variables. The tool prints a maximum relative difference of 4.65e-01 on s_in_cp; the exact ratio is 0.4649716293. The eight variables above rtol=0.001 are h_in_turb, h_out_turb, h_out_turb_is, h_in_cp, h_out_cp, h_out_cp_is, s_in_turb and s_in_cp. Saturated liquid R134a at -40 °C in this binary is h = 148144.0457993 J/kg and s = 795.6104944626 J/kg-K, where EES sets h = s = 0. CoolSolve minus EES is 148169.47 to 148198.50 J/kg on the six enthalpies and 795.69258 to 795.74885 J/kg-K on the two entropies. After subtracting that reference, the residuals are 25.42 to 54.46 J/kg and 0.082 to 0.138 J/kg-K. Turbine enthalpy drop -21623.165 J/kg against -21618.245 J/kg. W_dot_turb, W_dot_cp and W_dot_turb_elec match exactly. m_dot relative difference 2.275e-04; T_in_turb 3.146e-04; p_out_cp 2.326e-05. The 24 CoolSolve-only names are the diagram arrays. 10 iterations with .initials, 10 without. The diagram block does not change the 24 original variables (relative difference 0).
